# Asia Vision Technology — B2B LED Display Manufacturer

> Leading B2B LED display manufacturer in Shenzhen. Wholesale supplier for LED display distributors, system integrators, AV installers, rental & staging companies, advertising agencies, government contractors, and engineering firms. 12 product series: COB fine pitch (P0.9-P1.86), SMD indoor (P1.25-P4), outdoor IP65/IP66 (P4-P10), rental (P2.6-P4.81), transparent/creative, LCD video wall, and digital signage. ISO/CE/RoHS/FCC certified. OEM/ODM manufacturing available. Serving distributors, integrators and rental fleets worldwide.

## Product Lines (12 Series)

- [CV-PRO — COB Fine-Pitch LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/cob-cv-pro.html): COB chip-on-board fine pitch, high contrast — control rooms, broadcast, corporate interiors
- [RH-PRO — Fine Pitch COB Flagship](https://asiavisionled.com/products/rh-pro-cob.html): full-redundancy fine pitch COB for 24/7 mission-critical walls
- [EF — Outdoor COB LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/cob-ef.html): outdoor COB, IP-rated, high brightness
- [EH-PRO — IP65 Outdoor COB LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/cob-eh-pro.html): outdoor fine-pitch COB with IP65 sealing
- [Z Series — Rental COB LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/cob-z.html): 500x500mm rental cabinet, +/-5 degrees curving, 7680Hz for camera work
- [ZH Series — COB Touring LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/cob-zh.html): 500x1000x94mm touring cabinet, -7.5 to +7.5 degrees curving, wind rated to 20 m/s
- [D-PRO — Outdoor SMD LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/d-pro.html): IP65 outdoor SMD with high brightness and front maintenance
- [M-PRO — Indoor Small Pitch LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/m-pro.html): indoor small pitch for boardrooms, retail and corporate
- [R-PRO — Indoor Fixed LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/r-pro.html): indoor fixed installation range
- [S Series — Rental LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/s-series.html): indoor and outdoor rental cabinets for events and touring
- [E-PRO — XR Studio Rental LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/e-pro.html): rental panels for XR studios and virtual production
- [X Series — All-Platform LED Display](https://asiavisionled.com/products/x-series.html): one cabinet ecosystem across COB, SMD and GOB
